knowledgeAnswers.rationale: VBA note (2018), drain-design section: drawn suction points must be spaced 600 mm or more from one another.
VBA note (2018): outlet covers must be installed and tested as required; a damaged cover is a hazard to act on at once.
VBA note (2018), pipework-connection section: drain lines joining the sewer are plumbing work for a licensed plumber.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied pool, checks each outlet cover is present, undamaged and fixed, and records the result.
For a supplied cracked cover, takes the pool out of service and records the report without operating the pool.
Identifies from a supplied connection scenario whether plumbing licensing applies, and gives the reason.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Outlet cover check record for the assessed pool
Out-of-service record in a supplied scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Outlet cover missing, cracked or loose: take the pool out of service and report.
Untested replacement cover offered: do not fit it.
Sewer connection proposed without a licensed plumber: stop and escalate.
